IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:

Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 27 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then turning northeasterly in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Becoming cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Saturday 28 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming southerly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending southwesterly during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon or evening.

Sunday 29 November
Winds: Westerly about 10 knots increasing to 10 to 15 knots during the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high to the east of the state is expected to slowly move away, across the Tasman Sea, until the end of the week while maintaining a weak ridge over Tasmania. A trough over Victoria will extend over northwestern waters on Friday then move over Tasmania on Saturday morning, before moving away to the east. A cold front arrives during the day Sunday.
